text:
nina: Heads-up: planning to publish a ratecard housekeeping update (v3.2) next Tues. This is mainly labeling/versioning, examples, and two policy clarifications: (1) trial credits expire after 120 days; (2) discounts stack only within a SKU family. Need signoff from deal desk + finance + billing.
devon-sales: Can you surface the minimal customer-facing line so AEs can copy/paste into renewal threads?
hera-dealdesk: Quick note: we need to ensure the deal desk form enforces the new stacking rule. Any multi-family discount requests should escalate to legal.
ina: Draft AE line for copy: "We updated our ratecard docs to clarify trial expiry and how discounts apply across product families; this does not change existing committed amounts." Short and neutral.
oli-finance: Oli here. On trial expiry: do expired trial credits auto-forfeit or convert to 1-off promotional credit? Need to know for revenue deferral.
nina: For v3.2 we will auto-forfeit expired trial credits (no conversion). We'll document the rationale to reduce small-balance AR churn.
mike-billing: Billing ops needs a GL tag and an invoice memo text. propose tag: TRIAL_FORFEIT_120 and invoice line: "Trial credit expired (forfeited)".
oli-finance: OK add that tag. Also request a reportable boolean on deals so Finance can filter grandfathered trials in the audit export.
hera-dealdesk: For grandfathering: propose policy: trials started <= publish_date keep previous expiry (180d). Will add a checkbox in the form to mark grandfathered trials.
tara-legal: If you add a checkbox, ensure contract language doesn't imply an entitlement beyond the specified term. I'll review the snippet.
ina: Contract snippet planned: "Trial credits are time-limited and non-transferable. Credits lapse after the stated expiry and are not convertible to cash or other account credits, except where explicitly documented in writing by Redwood Inference."
tara-legal: Good. Suggest adding: "exceptions require written approval from Deal Desk and Finance."
hera-dealdesk: We'll require proof of trial start date for any exception. Also adding automated form rule: if discount_pct > 30 and sku_families > 1 then require legal_approval.
devon-sales: AEs will want examples. Can you add two tiny examples to the doc? 1) multi-SKU no stacking; 2) add-on support separate.
nina: Will add examples: 
Example 1: Model API + Embeddings. Each family applies its own discount band; bands do not compound across families.
Example 2: Support credits are billed separately and do not consume commit credits.
mike-billing: Ops note: to auto-apply forfeits we need a mapping file with account flags. I'll post a CSV template to #eng-ops after this is locked.
oli-finance: Approve pending GL tag and audit exportability.
hera-dealdesk: Approve from deal desk side; will update form rules and templates.
tara-legal: Approve subject to final wording tweak (add exception sentence).
ina: Great. Final checklist: billing CSV template (mike), GL tag + export (oli), deal desk form rules (hera), legal snippet (tara). If all approved by EOD Monday we publish Tuesday.
ratecard-bot: Reminder: Submit exceptions via Deal Desk with label `ratecard-v3.2`. Required fields: customer, sku_families, discount_pct, trial_start_date, justification. https://redwood/deal-desk/new :robot_face:
